exceptions.reason: The current official GScan 6.x release depends on extract-zip 2.0.1 and no patched extract-zip release exists. GScan remains required for Ghost 6 theme compatibility checks.
mitigations: GScan is invoked only against the repository-controlled theme directory.
No external or user-supplied ZIP is passed to GScan.
The release ZIP is created and re-opened with fflate under a strict file allowlist.
GScan and all development dependencies are excluded from the uploaded theme ZIP.
